complexity.notes: The dropped `import math` was dead code; good cleanup. sum() honors the letter of the constraint but not its spirit — the intended approach uses ||bitwise XOR for the carry-free sum and (a & b) << 1 for the carry, looping until the carry is zero||, which is O(1) for machine-width integers. Two-element list construction is fine, though sum((a, b)) avoids allocating a list.
complexity.summary: Sidesteps the operator ban by calling the built-in sum() on the two-element list [a, b].
